title: Key handover body
description: Key rotation as a handover (register row X7; the owner's answer; spec-delta S1427): an identity cannot change its key, so a rotation is a NEW identity linked to the old one by this record. It is signed by the OLD key (`issuer` is `old`) and countersigned by the NEW key, so both keys consent; the new identity must already have its own passport. From the record on the old identity is retired: it signs nothing more (`identity_handed_over`), its standing (tier, slashes, strikes, accepted and counted jobs) and its balance pass to the new identity in the same step, and anyone can follow the chain old to new (`EventLog.handoverChain`). A lost key cannot do this (nothing signs it: that is recovery, for a sponsor to vouch for a new identity); a stolen key can, which is why the old key's holder revokes by handing over first. Chain: none (prev is null).
